317:     def forward(self, point_feats, query, point_mask,
318:                 cluster_feats_list, child_cluster_maps, cluster_ids_list):
319:         """
320:         Args:
321:             point_feats: [B, N, C]  padded inst_feats
322:             query: [B, Q, C]  (仅用于 C2F 路由, 不修改)
323:             point_mask: [B, N]  True = padding
324:             cluster_feats_list: list of [B, K_lvl, C]
325:             child_cluster_maps: list of list(dict)  父子映射
326:             cluster_ids_list: list of list([N_b])  每级每个点的 cluster id
327:         Returns:
328:             {'point': fm}  仅返回 point message
329:         """
330:         B, Q, _ = query.shape
331:         num_scales = self.num_scales
332: 
333:         prev_indices = None
334: 
335:         for lvl in reversed(range(num_scales)):
336:             cf = cluster_feats_list[lvl]
337:             topk = min(self.per_layer_topk_list[lvl], cf.shape[1])
338: 
339:             if lvl == num_scales - 1:
340:                 # 最粗层：全选
341:                 _qctx, scores = self._scale_attn(query, cf)
342:                 prev_indices = scores.topk(topk, dim=-1).indices
343:             else:
344:                 # 细层：子簇候选
345:                 cmask = self._child_mask(prev_indices, child_cluster_maps[lvl],
346:                                          cf.shape[1], B, Q, cf.device)
347:                 if cmask.any():
348:                     _qctx, scores = self._scale_attn(query, cf, candidate_mask=cmask)
349:                     ms = scores.masked_fill(~cmask, -1e9)
350:                 else:
351:                     _qctx, scores = self._scale_attn(query, cf)
352:                     ms = scores
353:                 prev_indices = ms.topk(topk, dim=-1).indices
354: 
355:         # C2F 路由完成后, 一次性将聚合好的多尺度 cluster tokens 映射回原始点
356:         fm = self._cluster_to_points(point_feats, cluster_feats_list,
357:                                      cluster_ids_list, point_mask)
358:         fm = self.message_norm(fm).masked_fill(point_mask.unsqueeze(-1), 0)
359: 
360:         return {'point': fm}

134:     def __init__(self, cluster_layer_nums=None, cluster_pool_type='mean', d_model=None):
135:         super().__init__()
136:         if cluster_layer_nums is None:
137:             cluster_layer_nums = [256, 64, 8]
138:         self.cluster_layer_nums = list(cluster_layer_nums)
139:         self.cluster_pool_type = cluster_pool_type
140:         self.partitioner = PointCloudPartitioner(cluster_layer_nums=self.cluster_layer_nums)
141:         if cluster_pool_type == 'dual':
142:             assert d_model is not None, "d_model required for dual-branch cluster aggregation"
143:             self.dual_proj = nn.Sequential(
144:                 nn.Linear(2 * d_model, d_model),
145:                 nn.LayerNorm(d_model),
146:                 nn.ReLU(),
147:                 nn.Linear(d_model, d_model),
148:             )

150:     def get_cluster(self, sp_pos, batch_offsets):
151:         self.cluster_ids_list, self.child_cluster_maps = self.partitioner(sp_pos, batch_offsets)

153:     def build_cluster_feats(self, sp_feats, batch_offsets):
154:         """级联聚合：lvl0从原始点聚合成256token/batch，lvl1从256聚合成64/batch，lvl2从64聚合成8/batch"""
155:         device = sp_feats.device
156:         B = len(batch_offsets) - 1
157:         cluster_feats_list = []
158:         current_feats = sp_feats  # [total_N, C]
159:         for lvl in range(len(self.cluster_layer_nums)):
160:             ids_list = self.cluster_ids_list[lvl]
161:             # Per-batch remap: add cumulative offset so ids are globally unique
162:             remapped_ids = []
163:             cum = 0
164:             per_batch_K = []
165:             for b in range(B):
166:                 ids_b = ids_list[b]
167:                 remapped_ids.append(ids_b + cum)
168:                 Kb = int(ids_b.max().item()) + 1 if ids_b.numel() > 0 else 0
169:                 cum += Kb
170:                 per_batch_K.append(Kb)
171:             flat_ids = torch.cat(remapped_ids, dim=0)
172:             total_K = cum
173:             if self.cluster_pool_type == 'dual':
174:                 mean_feats = aggregate_cluster(current_feats, flat_ids, pool_type='mean')  # [total_K, C]
175:                 max_feats = aggregate_cluster(current_feats, flat_ids, pool_type='max')    # [total_K, C]
176:                 current_feats = self.dual_proj(torch.cat([mean_feats, max_feats], dim=-1))  # [total_K, C]
177:             else:
178:                 current_feats = aggregate_cluster(current_feats, flat_ids, pool_type=self.cluster_pool_type)  # [total_K, C]
179:             # Split back into per-batch tensors and pad
180:             padded_batches = []
181:             off = 0
182:             for b in range(B):
183:                 Kb = per_batch_K[b]
184:                 cf_b = current_feats[off:off+Kb]
185:                 off += Kb
186:                 padded_batches.append(cf_b)
187:             max_K = max(cf.shape[0] for cf in padded_batches)
188:             pad_list = []
189:             for cf in padded_batches:
190:                 if cf.shape[0] < max_K:
191:                     pad = torch.zeros(max_K - cf.shape[0], cf.shape[1], device=device, dtype=cf.dtype)
192:                     cf = torch.cat([cf, pad], dim=0)
193:                 pad_list.append(cf)
194:             cluster_feats_list.append(torch.stack(pad_list, dim=0))
195:         return cluster_feats_list

541:     def __init__(self, d_model=256, nhead=8, cluster_layer_nums=None,
542:                  per_layer_topk_list=None, dropout=0.0):
543:         super().__init__(d_model=d_model, nhead=nhead,
544:                          cluster_layer_nums=cluster_layer_nums,
545:                          per_layer_topk_list=per_layer_topk_list,
546:                          dropout=dropout)
547:         num_scales = len(cluster_layer_nums) if cluster_layer_nums else 3
548: 
549:         # Per-scale FFN: 2-layer MLP with GELU
550:         self.cluster_ffn = nn.ModuleList([
551:             nn.Sequential(
552:                 nn.Linear(d_model, d_model * 4),
553:                 nn.GELU(),
554:                 nn.Dropout(dropout),
555:                 nn.Linear(d_model * 4, d_model),
556:                 nn.Dropout(dropout),
557:             ) for _ in range(num_scales)
558:         ])
559:         # Per-scale LayerNorm (pre-norm style)
560:         self.cluster_ffn_norm = nn.ModuleList([
561:             nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(num_scales)
562:         ])

564:     def forward(self, point_feats, query, point_mask,
565:                 cluster_feats_list, child_cluster_maps, cluster_ids_list):
566:         # Skip routing (like DRP). Apply per-scale FFN refinement to cluster tokens.
567:         refined_cluster_feats = []
568:         for lvl in range(self.num_scales):
569:             cf = cluster_feats_list[lvl]  # [B, K_lvl, C]
570:             # Pre-norm residual FFN
571:             refined = cf + self.cluster_ffn[lvl](self.cluster_ffn_norm[lvl](cf))
572:             refined_cluster_feats.append(refined)
573: 
574:         point_message = self._cluster_to_points(
575:             point_feats, refined_cluster_feats, cluster_ids_list, point_mask)
576:         point_message = self.message_norm(point_message)
577:         point_message = point_message.masked_fill(point_mask.unsqueeze(-1), 0)
578:         return {'point': point_message}

596:     def _cluster_to_points(self, point_feats, cluster_feats_list,
597:                            cluster_ids_list, point_mask):
598:         B, N, C = point_feats.shape
599:         num_scales = self.num_scales
600: 
601:         composed_ids = []
602:         for b in range(B):
603:             ids_l0 = cluster_ids_list[0][b].long()
604:             ids_l0 = ids_l0.clamp(min=0, max=cluster_feats_list[0].shape[1] - 1)
605:             level_ids = [ids_l0]
606:             for lvl in range(1, num_scales):
607:                 parent_ids = cluster_ids_list[lvl][b].long()
608:                 parent_ids = parent_ids.clamp(
609:                     min=0, max=cluster_feats_list[lvl].shape[1] - 1)
610:                 level_ids.append(parent_ids.gather(0, level_ids[-1]))
611:             composed_ids.append(level_ids)
612: 
613:         scale_msgs = []
614:         for lvl in range(num_scales):
615:             cf = cluster_feats_list[lvl]
616:             msg = torch.zeros(B, N, C, device=point_feats.device, dtype=point_feats.dtype)
617:             for b in range(B):
618:                 ids_b = composed_ids[b][lvl]
619:                 n_valid = min(ids_b.shape[0], N)
620:                 msg[b, :n_valid] = cf[b, ids_b[:n_valid]]
621:             scale_msgs.append(msg)
622: 
623:         stack = torch.stack(scale_msgs, dim=-1)
624:         global_mean = point_feats.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True).expand_as(point_feats)
625:         gate_in = torch.cat([point_feats, global_mean], dim=-1)
626:         lw = torch.softmax(self.level_gate(gate_in), dim=-1)
627:         fused = (stack * lw.unsqueeze(-2)).sum(dim=-1)
628:         fused = self.point_out_proj(self.dropout(fused))
629:         return fused.masked_fill(point_mask.unsqueeze(-1), 0)
